input.quote: 20.1 Vendor shall defend, indemnify, and hold harmless Customer, its Affiliates, and their directors, officers, employees, and agents from each third-party claim and resulting damages, settlements, judgments, penalties, costs, and reasonable attorneys' fees arising from an allegation that the Services or Deliverables infringe or misappropriate an intellectual property right.
input.rationale: The indemnity package meets our preferred position in full. Section 20.1 gives an unqualified Vendor defence and indemnity for third-party IP infringement/misappropriation claims covering Customer, its Affiliates and their personnel, with no Customer-modification or combination carve-outs. Section 20.2 adds Vendor indemnities for breach of Applicable Law, bodily injury/property damage, unauthorized access to or disclosure of Customer Data caused by Vendor, and Vendor's gross negligence, wilful misconduct or fraud. Section 20.3 keeps Customer's reverse indemnity narrow (unmodified Customer-supplied material used strictly as authorized, and Customer's own violation of Applicable Law), with express carve-outs for Vendor Technology, modification, combination or instructions. Section 20.4 sets balanced procedure (prompt notice with material-prejudice limitation, cooperation at the indemnifying Party's expense, control of defence, settlement consent protections), and 20.5 provides the procure/modify/replace/refund mitigation remedy without allowing termination of unaffected Services. Indemnification obligations are "Excluded Claims" under 21.3, so they sit outside the mutual cap in 21.1 — better than the 3× super-cap fallback. No redline required.
